notes: Adds a separate read-only Reading Mode opened with an open-book icon
Reading Mode hides the keyboard and all writing bars
Tap the left or right side for immediate page changes
Tap the centre to reveal page number and A− / A+ controls
The book control becomes a pen for returning to Write Mode
Reading text size is remembered and never changes the writing document
Returns to approximately the same passage without reopening the keyboard
Writing mode, Focus Mode, autosave and formatting are otherwise unchanged
